steps.title: Analyze Build Failure Logs
steps.description: Inspect compilation output to identify AAPT linking failure cause inside activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Diagnose Invalid Layout Attributes
steps.description: Locate invalid 'match_height' value assigned to android:layout_width inside the root RelativeLayout.

steps.title: Fix Layout XML Error
steps.description: Correct root RelativeLayout android:layout_width property to match_parent to resolve AAPT resource linking crash.

steps.title: Verify Nested View Dimensions
steps.description: Scan XML sub-hierarchies to ensure correct dimensions are applied to all ScrollViews, Buttons and Forms.

steps.title: Review SQLite Queries Integrity
steps.description: Perform safety checks on DatabaseHelper raw SQL create statements in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Namespace
steps.description: Audit AndroidManifest.xml package and launch intent elements configurations.

steps.title: Check Java 8 Compiler Compliance
steps.description: Confirm no incompatible Java 9+ features or lambda expressions exist in MainActivity.

steps.title: Re-align Build Configurations
steps.description: Ensure build.gradle targets Java 1.8 compatibility and aligns with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5 parameters.

steps.title: Review App Metadata Configurations
steps.description: Verify metadata parameters inside app-meta.json synchronize with corrected project modules.

steps.title: Building Student Admin Pro
steps.description: Run the Gradle compiler compilation task to assemble the error-free debug APK output.
